subject: general
question: What is the full form of TEDP, which is a structured training programme of the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Technology Based Entrepreneurship Development Programme**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The full form of TEDP is **Technology Based Entrepreneurship Development Programme**.
 
• **About TEDP:**
 
 
• Initiated by the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Government of India: This program aims to nurture and support aspiring entrepreneurs with a focus on science and technology.
 
• **Structured Training:** TEDP provides comprehensive training to individuals, equipping them with the necessary skills and knowledge to launch and successfully run technology-based businesses.
 
• **Focus on Innovation**: The program emphasizes the development and commercialization of innovative products, technologies, and processes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• TEDP typically covers a wide range of topics, including:
 
• **Business Planning:** Developing detailed business plans, including market research, financial projections, and go-to-market strategies.
 
• **Technology Commercialization**: Understanding intellectual property rights (IPR), technology transfer mechanisms, and strategies for bringing innovative technologies to the market.
 
• **Entrepreneurial Skills**: Developing essential skills such as leadership, teamwork, communication, problem-solving, and financial management.
 
• **Mentorship and Networking:** Providing access to mentors, industry experts, and potential investors to guide and support entrepreneurs.
